categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, development, manufacturing, and sales of precision medical device components and products. Key segments include home respiratory machine components, cochlear implant components, precision molds and automation equipment, pulmonary function instruments, and other medical device components. It also has non-medical business segments leveraging its precision manufacturing capabilities in personal care, coffee, sports, maternal and infant, beauty, health, and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as precision mold design and manufacturing, liquid silicone rubber (LSR) molding, automated and intelligent manufacturing systems integrating AI and robotics, multi-material injection molding, micro-extrusion, and precision assembly. It has developed modular reusable general technology platforms and specialized technology platforms for vertical medical device fields, supported by ISO13485 quality management and compliance with FDA, CE, and NMPA regulations. The company also focuses on R&D in electrochemical sensors, multi-cavity molds, and high-precision extrusion technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves global leading medical device enterprises, especially in home respiratory devices and cochlear implants, with long-term strategic partnerships. Its customers include top 100 global medical device companies and innovative high-tech medical enterprises across respiratory health, hearing rehabilitation, blood glucose management, cardiovascular, and in vitro diagnostics. The end markets include hospitals, clinics, community health centers, elderly care institutions, disease control centers, third-party laboratories, and home users worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Huizhou, and overseas in Malaysia (Penang). It has subsidiaries and business presence in Hong Kong, Malaysia, Singapore, Cayman Islands, and Suzhou. Overseas production facilities support global supply chains, especially serving customers in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions. The company is expanding its global footprint with ongoing construction of additional overseas production capacity.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain, providing contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) services. It offers end-to-end services from product design and development to mass production and delivery, including specialized manufacturing of precision components and assembly for medical device OEMs. It also undertakes MAH (Marketing Authorization Holder) production services for international medical device brands in China.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening R&D in core medical device fields such as respiratory health, hearing rehabilitation, blood glucose management, cardiovascular, and in vitro diagnostics. The company emphasizes innovation in precision manufacturing, automation, digitalization, and AI integration. It invests heavily in developing modular technology platforms, specialized vertical technologies, and expanding global production and R&D capabilities. Future R&D focuses on new product development, advanced materials, multi-material molding, sensor technologies, and intelligent manufacturing systems.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through sales of precision medical device components, finished medical products, precision molds, and automated production systems. Revenue is derived from customized contract manufacturing services (CDMO) and sales of proprietary products. The sales model includes direct sales for components and molds, and distribution channels for proprietary medical devices. The company also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading global medical technology CDMO service provider, especially in home respiratory and cochlear implant component markets. It competes with global top medical device manufacturers and specialized CDMO providers. The industry is highly concentrated with top global players mainly from the US, Europe, and Japan. The company leverages its advanced manufacturing, quality systems, and global production footprint to compete effectively and expand market share, particularly in emerging high-growth medical device segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.59 billion, a 19.19% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 363.78 million, up 16.11%. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory with increasing R&D investment (8.82% of revenue) and expanding global production capacity. It has total assets of about RMB 3.92 billion and net assets of RMB 3.48 billion as of year-end 2024. The company’s revenue is predominantly from overseas sales (86.64%).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop service capability from product design to high-end manufacturing, supported by modular and specialized technology platforms. It differentiates through advanced automation and intelligent manufacturing systems achieving micron-level precision, strict quality and regulatory compliance (ISO13485, FDA, CE, NMPA), and strong global production base layout. Its deep collaboration with global top medical device companies and continuous innovation in core technologies provide competitive advantages in product quality, customization, and delivery reliability.
